<a id="nestedblock--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `provider` (String) Provider refers to the cluster type (e.g. AKS, GKE, EKS)
- `stage` (String) Stage is the name of the stage for this cluster

Optional:

- `allocation` (Block List, Max: 1) Allocation describes which workspaces can use this cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--allocation))
- `channel` (String) Channel describes the channel a cluster follows. On create, you must populate either channel or version, but not both.
- `cloud_access_config_ref` (Block List, Max: 1) CloudAccessConfigRef is a reference to the cloud access configuration to use when building the cluster (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--cloud_access_config_ref))
- `cloud_resource_name` (String) CloudResourceName specifies the name of the cluster in the cloud Can be left blank so that the name is derived from the wayfinder workspace and resource name
- `description` (String) Description provides a short summary to the use of the cluster
- `enable_auto_upgrade` (Boolean) EnableAutoUpgrade indicates wayfinder should handle any upgrades for the clusters
- `enable_private_cluster` (Boolean) EnablePrivateCluster indicates the cluster should be made private
- `expires` (String) Expires provides the duration (TTL) before automatic expiration of the cluster
- `maintenance` (Block List, Max: 1) Maintenance provides the details around the maintenance window (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--maintenance))
- `networking` (Block List, Max: 1) Networking provides the details around the cluster networking options (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--networking))
- `node_pools` (Block List) NodePools is a collection of node pools associated to the cluster (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--node_pools))
- `plan` (String) Plan refers to the original plan the cluster was created from
- `provider_details` (Block List, Max: 1) ProviderDetails defines cloud specific cluster options (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--provider_details))
- `quota_limits` (Block List, Max: 1) QuotaLimits provide defaults for quotas and limits which are critical for multi-tenancy (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--quota_limits))
- `region` (String) Region is the region you want the cluster to reside
- `secret_ref` (Block List, Max: 1) SecretRef is a reference to an existing secret containing an administrative access token for this cluster. Required only for clusters which are not created by Wayfinder. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--secret_ref))
- `security` (Block List, Max: 1) Security contains security settings for the cluster (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--security))
- `version` (String) Version is the kubernetes version to use. On create, you must populate either Channel or Version, but not both.

<a id="nestedblock--spec--node_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.node_pools`

Required:

- `image` (String) Image is the image we should use on the instances of this pool
- `machine` (String) Machine is the instance type of the nodes in the poll
- `size` (Number) Size is initial size if autoscaling defined - or the effective size if no autoscaling is enabled

Optional:

- `autoscaling` (Block List, Max: 1) Autoscaling indicates the node pool should autoscale (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--node_pools--autoscaling))
- `channel` (String) Channel describes the channel a NodePool follows If specified on a cluster, must be identical to the channel on the cluster
- `cloud_resource_name` (String) CloudResourceName is the name of the cloud resource - should not be set by the client - set by the NodePool mutate if empty - set by the NodePoolUpdate controller depending on the update type
- `default_update_options` (Block List, Max: 1) DefaultUpdateOptions defines how this nodepool can be upgraded - Used by the cluster controller to generate NodePoolUpdates based on spec changes - Ignored when a NodePoolUpdate is created directly (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--node_pools--default_update_options))
- `description` (String) Description provides an optional description to the node pool
- `disk_size` (Number) DiskSize is the amount of disk space to assign to the nodes in MBs
- `expires` (String) Expires provides a time for automatic expiration of the cluster
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels is a collection of label placed on to the nodepool
- `logical_name` (String) LogicalName is the internally unique name of the NodePool (not in cloud) - Should always be consistent with a single name entry in a Cluster or NodePoolUpdate - Has to be unique across all nodepools on the Cluster spec - Will NOT always match the name of the NodePool in cloud - Should be treated as an immutable field
- `max_pods_per_node` (Number) MaxPodsPerNode controls how many pods can be scheduled onto each node in this pool
- `provider_details` (Block List, Max: 1) ProviderDetails provides any cloud specific options for this nodepool (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--node_pools--provider_details))
- `spot` (Block List, Max: 1) Spot if defines enables nodepool to use spot instances (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--node_pools--spot))
- `taints` (Block List) Taints defines a collection scheduling taints placed on the nodepool (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--node_pools--taints))
- `version` (String) Version is the specified version of kubernetes on the node pool This cannot be set by a client if a channel is also specified Will be set by the NodePoolUpdate controller on actual nodepools if a channel is specified
- `zones` (List of String) Zones defines a list of cloud specific availability zones where the nodes are permitted to run

<a id="nestedblock--spec--provider_details--gke"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details.gke`

Optional:

- `enable_horizontal_pod_autoscaler` (Boolean) The Horizontal Pod Autoscaler changes the shape of your Kubernetes workload by automatically increasing or decreasing the number of Pods in response to the workload's CPU or memory consumption, or in response to custom metrics reported from within Kubernetes or external metrics from sources outside of your cluster.
- `enable_http_load_balancer` (Boolean) EnableHTTPLoadBalancer indicates if the cluster should be configured with the GKE ingress controller. When enabled GKE will autodiscover your ingress resources and provision load balancer on your behalf.
- `enable_shielded_nodes` (Boolean) EnableShieldedNodes indicates we should enable the shielded nodes options in GKE. This protects against a variety of attacks by hardening the underlying GKE node against rootkits and bootkits.
- `enable_stack_driver_logging` (Boolean) EnableStackDriverLogging indicates if Stackdriver logging should be enabled for the cluster
- `enable_stack_driver_metrics` (Boolean) EnableStackDriverMetrics indicates if Stackdriver metrics should be enabled for the cluster
- `master_ipv_4_cidr` (String) MasterIPV4Cidr is network range used when private networking is enabled. This is the peering subnet used to to GKE master api layer. Note, this must be unique within the network.

<a id="nestedblock--spec--quota_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.quota_limits`

Optional:

- `default` (String) Default specifies the default template name to use e.g. "Small" A specific template can be specified with labels on NamespaceClaim objects Required if a cluster is allocated for any tenant workspaces
- `templates` (Block List) Templates provide initial defaults for Quotas and Limits for allocated namespaces used when a cluster is allocated to other workspaces to control ResourceQuotas and LimitRanges These values will result in a one time creation of: - a new cluster workspace QuotaLimit object for "constraints" per workspace (with a namespace claim) - a tenant workspace QuotaLimit object for namespace defaults per workspace Required if a cluster is allocated for any tenant workspaces (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--quota_limits--templates))

<a id="nestedblock--spec--quota_limits--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.quota_limits.templates`

Required:

- `name` (String) TemplateName is the immutable name to track the tempate that was used Would normally specify a QuotaLimit "size" for a tenant

Optional:

- `constraints` (Block List, Max: 1) Constraints are for providing management of resource constraints to workloads - Typically only managed by cluster owners to provide hard resource constraints - Used to prevent noisy neigbor issues in a multi-tenanted environment (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--quota_limits--templates--constraints))
- `resource_defaults` (Block List) ResourceDefaults provide defaults for workloads (to prevent initial constraint violations) Not set directly or managed by owners (as only maximum values taken so should not conflict) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--quota_limits--templates--resource_defaults))

<a id="nestedblock--spec--quota_limits--templates--constraints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.quota_limits.templates.constraints`

Optional:

- `hard_quota` (Map of String) QuotaHard are applied as ResourceQuota objects to all namespaces for a tenant of that type There are the maximun resource usage in total for a namespace e.g.: hardQuota:
  requests.cpu: "1"
  requests.memory: "1Gi"
  limit.cpu: "2"
- `limit_ranges` (Block List) LimitRanges (in the context of constraints) are applied as LimitRanges (using Max) These are the largest values that can be used by a single resource in a namespace They will prevent workloads from using up all resources on a single node (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--quota_limits--templates--constraints--limit_ranges))

<a id="nestedblock--spec--quota_limits--templates--constraints--limit_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.quota_limits.templates.constraints.limit_ranges`

Required:

- `type` (String) Type of resource that this limit applies to.

Optional:

- `max` (Map of String) Max usage constraints on this kind by resource name.
- `max_limit_request_ratio` (Map of String) MaxLimitRequestRatio if specified, the named resource must have a request and limit that are both non-zero where limit divided by request is less than or equal to the enumerated value; this represents the max burst for the named resource.



<a id="nestedblock--spec--quota_limits--templates--resource_defaults"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.quota_limits.templates.resource_defaults`

Required:

- `type` (String) Type of resource that this limit applies to.

Optional:

- `default` (Map of String) Default resource requirement limit value by resource name if resource limit is omitted.
- `default_request` (Map of String) DefaultRequest is the default resource requirement request value by resource name if resource request is omitted.
